rationale: Four defects in the relationship GRAPH this lane published, each of them a fabricated or un-navigable ENDPOINT rather than a missing one, and each of them invisible to a per-type edge count because the count stayed healthy. (1) A construction that is WHOLE (carries its own arguments) whose receiver is read further along an access chain published the MEMBER as the constructed type: `New StackFrame(1).GetMethod().Name` gave `instantiates -> GetMethod`, and `New String() {"x","y"}.ToList()` would have given `-> ToList`. The "is my parent a member access whose object I am?" test cannot tell `New System.Text.StringBuilder` (a namespace prefix, where climbing is required) from `New StackFrame(1).GetMethod()` (a whole construction, where climbing fabricates). Measured on the lane corpus: 322 of the 15,543 construction nodes sitting in an access chain were whole constructions whose target was read off the wrong node, and an INDEPENDENT source-text oracle -- script/m14/vb-instantiates-oracle.ts, which reads no grammar at all, because a second walker over the same grammar cannot see a shared grammar bug -- put the error at 1.07% of all `instantiates` edges before the fix (targets `ToList` 59, `Message` 6, `Length` 4, `GetMethod` 4, `Contains` 4, `Clone` 2) and 0.00% after. (2) `Implements IEnumerable(Of String).GetEnumerator` published the target `IEnumerable(Of String).GetEnumerator`; the type arguments are not part of the name, so that string is in no symbol table. 94 of 286 `implements` edges -- the normal shape of a member-level interface implementation in generic VB code. (3) `Function F() As (Range As ValueRange, Name As String)` published the `references` target `(Range As ValueRange, Name As String)`: a PARAMETER LIST, because `namingToken` had no case for `tuple_type` and returned the node itself. 3 sites. (4) The same relationship row was emitted more than once in one file -- 6,590 rows over the corpus (references 3,813, instantiates 1,840, calls 935, imports 2) -- and `bb_impact` counts degrees, so three `As String` in one signature made `String` look three times as depended-upon. Every shape below is real VB source taken from the corpus pattern that produced each defect; a fixture that pins a shape the corpus never contains proves nothing about the corpus.

expectRelationships.comment: FIX 1a. The construction is WHOLE -- `New StackFrame(1)` -- so the constructed type is StackFrame. `.GetMethod` is a call on the object just built and `.Name` a property of its result; neither is a type anything constructs.

FIX 1b, and the half that must NOT regress. `New System.Text.StringBuilder` holds only `New System`; the type continues in the access chain, so climbing is REQUIRED and StringBuilder is the answer. This row is the control for the fix: a repair that stopped climbing would satisfy the forbid rows above while making this one disappear, so it is pinned.

FIX 2. The type arguments are dropped, and the arity is recorded so the reduction is visible rather than silent. The target keeps its `IEnumerable` qualifier deliberately: `GetEnumerator` alone would collapse `implements GetEnumerator -> GetEnumerator`, a self-edge that answers none of the questions anyone asks of it.
FIX 3. A tuple type names SEVERAL types, so it emits one `references` edge per element rather than the single name `namingToken` could return.
FIX 3, second element. Both are `role: returnType` because both element types are part of the declared return type.

FIX 4. Three `As String` reads on ONE line collapsed to ONE row, and `duplicateRows: 3` keeps the raw count visible so the dedupe hides nothing. `roles` records that the collapsed copies were not all the same fact.

FIX 4 does NOT collapse across lines. Two constructions of one type on two lines are two facts about the program, and the M59.A7 per-site line contract requires both rows -- a per-pair dedupe would silently discard it. `sites` on the `uses` row below is the paired fact: same target, two read sites, one edge.
The read of `.Name` happens twice on two lines and is ONE `uses` edge with `sites: 2`, which is the family's own `uses` dedupe (csharp keys on `source::uses::name`).
A member READ is a `uses` edge, and the reads are `.Empty` and `.Count` off a generic-qualified name -- neither is a call and neither is an index, so both are the value slot.
`System.Text` inside `New System.Text.StringBuilder` is the namespace continuation. The chain's non-identifier segments are not reads of a member, so the emitted read is the last segment.

forbidRelationships.comment: FIX 1a forbid. The pre-fix analyzer climbed the access chain off a construction that carried its own arguments and published the METHOD. This row is what makes the mutant `construction-climbs-any-access-chain` die.
FIX 1a forbid, second form. `New StackFrame(1).GetMethod().Name` climbs two levels, so the old code published the OUTER member as well.

FIX 1b forbid. `New String() {"x", "y"}.ToList()` -- the arguments are an `array_initializer`, not a `bounds` field, so the pre-fix `bounds`-only reasoning still climbed and named the method. 59 `ToList` targets on a 200-file draw came from this shape.
FIX 2 forbid. The type arguments are not part of a name; this string is in no symbol table and no oracle can match it.
FIX 3 forbid. The whole `( ... )` tuple text is a PARAMETER LIST, not a name: not written as an identifier anywhere, not navigable, and unmatchable.

expectRelationshipCount.comment: FIX 4, stated as an exact count rather than as a forbid, because a `forbid` on `references ThreeStrings -> String` would contradict the legitimate single row above and fail for the wrong reason. Three `As String` reads at one line, ONE row. This exact count is the assertion that kills a mutant which restores the duplicate emission: the row is present either way, so nothing except the count can see it.
FIX 4, per line. Two lines, two rows -- the dedupe is per (source, target, type, LINE), not per pair. A mutant that dedupes per PAIR would report 1 here and fail.

expectMetadata.comment: The disclosure rule, pinned whole rather than per key, because `expectMetadata` compares `metadata[k]` with strict JSON equality and a dotted key like `vbGaps.construction-without-readable-name` would resolve to a top-level field that does not exist -- an UNSATISFIABLE assertion that reads as coverage. `New String() {"x", "y"}` puts an `array_type` wrapping a `predefined_type` in the construction's `type` field, and a `predefined_type` is a keyword token with no identifier leaf under it, so there is no name to publish. The edge is not invented and it is not silently dropped: the count is here. `relationship-duplicate-rows-collapsed: 1` is the FIX 4 disclosure -- one file had identical rows to collapse, so the count is the number of FILES in which a collapse happened, not the number of rows, and that distinction is the reason it is named as it is.
